questions.stem: Work out 4 + 3 × 2, showing the order you do it in.
questions.explanation: Multiplication is done before addition and subtraction, so « 3 × 2 » is evaluated first. Working left to right instead gives 14, which is the commonest slip with this shape of expression.

questions.stem: A rectangle is 8 cm long and 5 cm wide. Find its area.
questions.explanation: Area of a rectangle is length × width, and the unit is squared because two lengths were multiplied. Adding the sides instead gives the perimeter, 26 cm, which is a different quantity.

questions.stem: A triangle has base 10 cm and height 6 cm. Find its area.
questions.explanation: A triangle is half the rectangle that boxes it in, which is where the ½ comes from. Forgetting it gives 60 cm² — exactly double, and the most frequent error on this formula.
